sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य परित्यागं प्रतिज्ञां राघवस्य च ।पुत्रयोरभिषेकं च पौरानुगमनं तथा ।। ७.१०८.३ ॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya parityāgaṁ pratijñāṁ rāghavasya ca ।putrayorabhiṣekaṁ ca paurānugamanaṁ tathā ।। 7.108.3 ॥

translations.english: They recounted Lakshmana's abandonment, Rama's vow, the coronation of his two sons, and the citizens' departure with him.
